Trace, implement and test: Is Palindrome String

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class IsPalindromeString {
    public static int getIsPalindromeString(String input1) {
        input1 = input1.toLowerCase();
        int digitCount = input1.length();
        boolean isPalindrome = true;

        int range = digitCount / 2;
        if (digitCount % 2 == 0) range--;

        for (int i = 0; i <= range; i++) {
            if (input1.charAt(i) != input1.charAt(digitCount - i - 1)) isPalindrome = false;
        }

        if (isPalindrome == true) return 2;
        else return 1;
    }
}
